### 5. `isolate` parameter data flow (precise navigation)

```
Tex(string, isolate=[R"\infty"])        [tex_mobject.py:26-65]
  → StringMobject.__init__(isolate=...) [string_mobject.py:46-78]
      self.isolate = isolate
      self.parse()                       [string_mobject.py:216]
          isolated_spans = self.find_spans_by_selector(self.isolate)  [string_mobject.py:221]
              → find_spans_by_selector   [string_mobject.py:175]
                  re.finditer(re.escape(sel), self.string) for str sel
          → contributes label entries to labelled_spans
          → labelled_spans used in get_submob_indices_list_by_span [string_mobject.py:440]
          → powers __getitem__(selector) [string_mobject.py:555]
              → select_parts(selector)   [string_mobject.py:548]
                  if selector in specified_substrings → use label span
                  else → select_unisolated_substring (path-count fallback)
```

The failing case (`equation[R"\infty"]` without `isolate`) hits `select_unisolated_substring` ([`string_mobject.py:569`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/manimlib/mobject/svg/string_mobject.py?L569-L579)), which counts glyphs by `substr_to_path_count`. For `\infty`, LaTeX renders it before `\sigma` in draw order while `\infty` appears after `\sum` in the source string — the glyph count index is therefore wrong. With `isolate`, the span is explicitly labeled during `parse()`, so `select_parts` uses label-based span lookup, bypassing the count-based fallback.

Navigation: **precise** (all by direct file read).
